information_interface.architecture: centralized same-tick fusion of four vehicle-local packets and one payload-coordinator packet
information_interface.noise_indexing: per absolute tick, node and field; entropy hashed per tick
information_interface.not_claimed: R5 proves interface transfer only. It does not establish distributed or communication-robust control; impairment injection belongs to E03/E05.

noiseless_no_op_gate.not_applicable: N1 changes the measurement noise by design and is not required to reproduce the noiseless run; it must pass the hard gates and report the performance change.

stop_rule: N0 failure stops N1. N1 violating a hard gate fails R5; no filter is added and the noise is not reduced to hide it.
refrozen_reason: r5_runner.py changed after this protocol was frozen (double-mkdir fix and caller-model passing), so the pinned hash was stale and the first R5-N1 launch was refused with IDENTITY_FILE_MISMATCH before creating any output.
